'''Kanno Sebak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] living on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Guild of Offworlder Skilled Laborers]], and met with [[President/Legends|President]] [[Cambira Ralle]] following the [[Faceless]] bombing on [[Grande Hyet]].
